transcription_notes: Blind glyph-faithful vision transcription of 1 Kings (3/4 Kingdoms) ch.2 from Cambridge UL MS Add. 1570 (CAM), a dense single scribal book hand in black/brown ink with red rubrication. Three text columns per folio (L,M,R) read L->M->R then the next folio; the f126v outer marginalia strip was ignored (out of scope). START bound: f126v col-L line 28, immediately after the red liturgical divider '✣ ክፍል ፡ ፫ ✣' (cross / 'kefl' / Ethiopic numeral 3 / cross), verified at 23x; v1 begins 'ወቀርቦ ...'. END bound: f127r col-L last line, final running word 'ለስሎሞን' (Solomon) which wraps the f127r-L -> f127r-M column turn; immediately after, at the top of f127r col-M, a red '✣ ክፍል ፡ ፰ ✣' (kefl 8) divider begins the NEXT chapter (Pharaoh king of Egypt) which is OUT OF SCOPE and excluded. The numeral legend for this chapter: Ethiopic 3 = U+136B (chapter-start kefl), 8 = U+1370 (next-chapter kefl), 2 = U+136A, 40 = U+1372, 7 = U+136F, 30 = U+1374 (the 40/7/30 occur written inline with red rubric corner-frames in new-v7 'David reigned 40 years in Hebron, 7 years, 30 and three years'). FIX-ROUND-1 (an independent adversarial reviewer re-read the parchment; every correction below was re-verified by this agent directly on the CAM images at 12-32x): (1) RESTORED ~9 lines of running BLACK scripture on f126v col-M that an earlier pass had dropped by HOMOEOTELEUTON - the scribal eye skipped from the FIRST occurrence of 'መቃብር' (end of the Joab charge, recorded end of old-v3) to the SECOND identical 'መቃብር' (end of the Shimei-son-of-Gera charge). The dropped text is the Barzillai-kindness clause and the Shimei-son-of-Gera charge. This was a genuine scribal eye-skip restore, NOT a recensional minus: there is no rubric/kefl in that gap and on the parchment the FIRST occurrence is followed by a single wordspace flowing straight into the next clause. The restored text was re-segmented at the scribe's own inline red cross into two new running sections (new-v4 = Barzillai + Shimei intro + oath, ending at that red cross; new-v5 = the concluding instruction, ending at the SECOND grave-word). The chapter is now 27 verses (was 25; every verse from the restore onward renumbered +2; v[].v is contiguous 1..27). (2) REMOVED a fabricated dittography in old-v15 / new-v17 on f126v-R: the parchment inks the 'because you were sick with all the sickness of my father, and Solomon banished Abiathar' clause ONCE; the spurious duplicate phrase and a spurious double full-stop that an earlier pass had inserted were deleted (parchment re-read at 30x).
